# SaaS Tax & Finance Compliance — Founder Awareness

This reference helps prepare questions for qualified tax and legal advisers. It does not determine tax liability, exemptions, filing obligations, or legal eligibility. Requirements depend on jurisdiction, entity structure, transaction date, and individual facts.

## When to seek advice

- Selling into a new jurisdiction or opening a foreign entity.
- Hiring employees or contractors across jurisdictions.
- Changing billing, marketplace, reseller, or payment arrangements.
- Issuing equity, transferring shares, fundraising, or preparing an exit.
- Considering research credits, capital-gains relief, or other tax incentives.

## Prepare a confidential handoff

Collect relevant entity records, dates, jurisdictions, contracts, cap-table details, and revenue categories in an access-controlled workspace. Share only what the adviser needs. Do not add customer, employee, tax, bank, or ownership records to a public repository.

## Questions for the adviser

| Topic | Questions |
| --- | --- |
| Sales tax and VAT/GST | Which registrations, collection rules, and filings apply to these facts? |
| Equity and exit | Which rules apply to the issuance and transaction dates, holding period, and entity structure? |
| Research incentives | Which activities and evidence are eligible under current rules? |
| Compensation | What payroll, classification, valuation, and reporting obligations apply? |
| Cross-border activity | What withholding, permanent-establishment, and transfer-pricing review is needed? |

## Sources and decision record

Use the relevant tax authority's current primary guidance and written advice from qualified professionals. Record the jurisdiction, effective date, facts relied on, adviser, and follow-up date. Do not apply generic online thresholds or historical examples as a legal conclusion.

- [IRS small-business resources](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed)
- [European Commission taxation information](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/index_en)

Public playbooks can explain the process; binding conclusions belong in the professional review.
